channel_configs:
CREATE TABLE channel_configs (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	project_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	channel_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	connection_mode VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	app_id VARCHAR, 
	app_secret VARCHAR, 
	encrypt_key VARCHAR, 
	verification_token VARCHAR, 
	webhook_url VARCHAR, 
	webhook_port INTEGER, 
	webhook_path VARCHAR, 
	domain VARCHAR, 
	extra_settings JSON, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	last_error TEXT, 
	description TEXT, 
	created_by VARCHAR, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(created_by) REFERENCES users (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_channel_configs_project_enabled ON channel_configs (project_id, enabled)
CREATE INDEX ix_channel_configs_project_type ON channel_configs (project_id, channel_type)
channel_messages:
CREATE TABLE channel_messages (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	channel_config_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	project_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	channel_message_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	chat_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	chat_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	sender_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	sender_name VARCHAR, 
	message_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	content_text TEXT, 
	content_data JSON, 
	reply_to VARCHAR, 
	mentions JSON, 
	direction VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	raw_data JSON, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(channel_config_id) REFERENCES channel_configs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
CREATE INDEX ix_channel_messages_config_time ON channel_messages (channel_config_id, created_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_channel_messages_project_chat ON channel_messages (project_id, chat_id)
